Five rectangular slots arranged vertically, passing through the width (X-axis).

relations.description: The central hole and the column of slots are aligned along the vertical centerline of the object.

symmetry.description: The object is symmetric about its vertical axis in the front view.

repetitions.description: Five identical rectangular slots spaced evenly along the height.

uncertainties: Exact thickness of the object (Y-axis) is inferred from the top view aspect ratio.
Exact depth of the slots (X-axis) is inferred from the front view width.
generation_notes: The object is modeled as a rectangular prism. The top view defines the cross-section in the XY plane (width x depth), including the central hole. The right view defines the side profile (depth x height), showing the slots. The front view confirms the overall height and width. The slots are interpreted as cuts through the width (X-axis) to hold cables, while the hole is a cut through the depth (Y-axis) for mounting.

parameters.note: Extrude the top view profile (width x depth) along the Z-axis to create the main body.
